name: Absorb Mix
subtitle: Experimental audiobook + external music companion
localizedDescription: An independent experimental Absorb fork for Audiobookshelf with opt-in iOS audio coexistence. Spotify plays in its own app using its existing login; Absorb Mix controls audiobook volume only. Spotify volume and transport are external/manual, and sleep timers stop or fade the audiobook only. This is not an app-owned Spotify mixer, and physical-device coexistence remains experimental. No affiliation with or endorsement by Spotify.
